profile_text: As a specialist in customer acquisition and retention, this direct marketing and digital services firm has achieved a 35.3% growth since its baseline, driven by its expertise in delivering tailored solutions for various industries. With a focus on digital services, the company has expanded its workforce to 157 employees in 2024, solidifying its position as a scaler in the information and communication sector. Its success is rooted in its ability to provide effective customer acquisition and retention strategies, leveraging its digital capabilities to drive business growth.
